elements.title: Il bacio (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Joo Koon train collision (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Johannes Nitsch (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Johannes Nitsch did not expect to win a seat in the Volkskammer because he was so far down his party list?

elements.title: Morgantown Mall (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Hana Monogatari (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the short story series Hana Monogatari was originally planned to end after seven entries, but overwhelmingly positive reader response led to a decade-long serialization?

elements.title: Suhas Kulkarni (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Suhas Kulkarni, an immigrant, decided to run for office after the proposal of legislation that would ban immigrants running for public office?
